name: Bloom Pack
summary: Bloom Level-Up with the RPG Series classes, spells and gear, dungeons, bosses (World Bosses, Remnants, Mutant Monsters, Ultimate Warden), levelled mobs, origins, Better Combat, a dodge roll, busier villages, shaders and animations, for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric).
_comment: The 'Start with' list (minus Better Animations Collection, which fights Fresh Animations, and Villager Guards, dropped for now) from the Bloom Pack mod list doc, plus Origins: Legacy, Villagers at Work / after Work, Fresh Animations' player extension (with the EMF compat mods it needs next to Not Enough Animations and Better Combat) and the 'Later' picks (Aerial Hell since removed: it crashed with Origins: Legacy): both Moog's structure mods, Homesteads, Ambient Creatures, Wandering Trader Maps and the Cave Horror datapack (server: world/datapacks). Then the RPG Series (Wizards, Paladins & Priests, Archers, Rogues & Warriors, Arsenal, Armory, Jewelry; Spell Engine and the rest come in as their dependencies) and Combat Roll. Structure Pool API says it's server-only, but the RPG mods require it on the client too (singleplayer). GeckoLib is for World Bosses and Fabric Language Kotlin for Villagers at Work (both CurseForge-only). Modrinth mods by slug (newest 26.3 Fabric build; required dependencies are added automatically). External files are packed inside (fine for sharing with friends, not for publishing). Batch 2 (boss and mob mods): Mutant Monsters, Remnants: The Eclipsed Realm (its bosses' dimension), Remnants: RPG Mobs and Ultimate Warden (an alpha for 26.3); Puzzles Lib, Forge Config API Port and JAuml come in as their dependencies. Moar Bosses was skipped: its library datapack and resource pack can't be re-shared.
_singleplayer_too: Server-only structure mods also installed on the client (with their libraries), so singleplayer worlds get them.

client_presets._resource_packs: Bottom to top, above vanilla's Default. Modrinth slugs, or id:<pack id> for packs built into a mod (Continuity's two).
client_presets._keys: Key bindings set once per change of this list (by name, as options.txt has them): the roll keeps R, Bloom's weapon skill moves to V (it was R), Iris's 'reload shaders' is unbound (it was R too), vanilla's Quick Actions is unbound so Origins' ability keeps G, and Origins' 'view origin' moves to U so O stays vanilla's Friends list.

config_files._comment: Config files for both sides (the server's rules, which a singleplayer world reads too), written as given. Combat Roll: a 5-tick (quarter second) window where hits don't land after a roll (FreshOrangeSlices' call); the rest are its defaults.
